title: TIMEGEAR
description: Timegear is a Neoforge 1.21.1 modpack designed to transform standard Minecraft into an adventure. It centers on automation with the Create mod, adds new biomes and items for exploration, and performance mods to increace stability.
body:
**Timegear official modpack**

Timegear is designed to transform Minecraft, and add new features, biomes, and items so you can have better experinces. designed on neoforge with many mods to create more posibilites.

**At its core, timegear centers on the _Create mod_. This modpack includes the full Create experience plus a collection of other mods to make complicated automation, resource management, and machine designing easier.**
* Timegear is based on Neoforge, and includes **performance-focused** optimization mods to ensure smoother gameplay and higher frame rates.

# PLEASE READ
**system requirments**
* recomended memory: 8GB (8192MB) less may induce stutters with Distant Horizons LODs on.\
**java arguments**\
Timegear is a heavily modded modpack, so we reccomend using the following java flags to increace performance.\
`-XX:+UnlockExperimentalVMOptions -XX:+UseZGC -XX:+ZGenerational`\
also use `-Xmx8G` if your launcher allows it.\
using those flags will increace performance with distant horizons LODs enabled.\
It is also reccomended to set the distant horizons detail to `medium`, LOD chunk render distance radius to `32`, and cpu load to `minimal impact`.

## Exploration
The pack includes mods that introduce new structures, biomes, and a lot of new items, making every exploration trip rewarding.


### Common questions

* **How do I know what to craft?**\
We include **jei** and some addons for it to allow you to see crafting recipes and more, even if you don't have it unlocked.

* **how does multiplayer change?**\
multiplayer has been enhanced with mods like Xearo's Minimap and World map, along with open parties and claims (OPAC) that adds chunk claming, and force chunk loading that intigrate seemlesly with Xearo's Mini and World maps.

* **What if i want to use shaders?**\
Timegear includes **Iris** by default, with **Complementary Unbound** and **Complementary Reimagined** shaderpacks pre-loaded. You can easily add your own shaders by placing the `.zip` file in the `shaderpacks` folder.

#### Community:
Join our [Discord server](https://discord.gg/wgJ7XFs8tD) for community discussions, support, and updates! We plan to open a public Minecraft server for timegear soon.
